newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak FinMin sets 42-week T-bill auction for Wed.
newsitem.headline: Slovak FinMin sets 42-week T-bill auction for Wed.

text.p: The Slovak Finance Ministry will auction an unspecified tranche of 42-week treasury bills on Wednesday, the central bank said on Monday.
This will be the first auction of finance ministry T-bills with a 42-week maturity this year.

In the last successful auction of the ministry's T-bills with a similar maturity -- 41-week T-bills issued on December 4 -- average yields hit 11.94 percent, up from 11.25 percent in the previous auction of similar T-bills.
